definitions.gloss: village chief, village head, village mayor
definitions.explanation: The elected head of a village (村) in Japan's local government system. Villages are the smallest unit of municipal government, found mainly in rural areas.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{村長|そんちょう}が{選|えら}ばれた。
examples.english: A new village mayor was elected.

examples.japanese: {村長|そんちょう}は{村民|そんみん}の{声|こえ}に{耳|みみ}を{傾|かたむ}けた。
examples.english: The village chief listened to the villagers' voices.

examples.japanese: {村長|そんちょう}{選挙|せんきょ}は{来月|らいげつ}{行|おこな}われるが、{立候補者|りっこうほしゃ}は{一人|ひとり}しかいない。
examples.english: The village mayoral election will be held next month, but there is only one candidate.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan's local government hierarchy, the heads of different municipal levels have different titles:
- {市長|しちょう}: city mayor
- {町長|ちょうちょう}: town mayor
- {村長|そんちょう}: village mayor

{村|むら} (village) is the smallest administrative unit. The number of villages in Japan has been declining due to municipal mergers.

NOTE: This is a homophone of {尊重|そんちょう} (respect).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {村長|そんちょう}{選挙|せんきょ}: village mayoral election
- {村長|そんちょう}に{就任|しゅうにん}する: to take office as village chief
- {村長|そんちょう}{室|しつ}: village chief's office
